Argument.Label: &Value
Argument.Description: The value from which to extract a sub-string.

Argument.Label: &Start position (0-based)
Argument.Description: The position of the first character, starting at 0. For example, if Value = "ETLForge", position 2 corresponds to the first "t".

Argument.Label: &Length
Argument.Description: The length of the sub-string to extract.
